last_message: Added `docs/adr/0003-weigh-a-new-service-against-postgres.md`, which writes down Ana's rule from `notes/issue-70.md`: a new service needs something Postgres can't do, plus two volunteers who can restore it — with the 2023 Redis-sessions, March-2025 Redis-queue, and October-2025 Elasticsearch episodes as the evidence, and the card gateway noted as the kind of exception the rule doesn't cover. Linked it from `docs/adr/README.md` alongside the other two ADRs. Next proposal can start there instead of rediscovering it a fourth time.
